Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3f74c57a590c81268d2fc9bea7860064 as of 2026-10-12T03:11:19.481Z: {"title":"FC-01 P20 Independent Verification Design v0.1 — DESIGN FROZEN / CONTROL RECONCILIATION NEXT"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🧪"} > **FC-01 P20 Independent Verification Design v0.1 — DESIGN_FROZEN_WITH_FINDINGS / READY_FOR_CONTROL_RECONCILIATION (2026-10-12).** Primary Owner: aegis-verification. This document freezes **requirement, oracle, failure mode, evidence qualification and terminal criteria**, NOT execution evidence, an implemented fixture, an independent P34 verdict, new semantic Authority, a public ABI, or a physical PASS. Existing original PX0-07/G4.6-C/G4.7 physical obligations and FC-13 source-subject mapping remain untouched. FC-01 P31/P32 are **NOT_AUTHORIZED**. ## 0. Trust boundary / exact input identities - **Current scoped execution Authority:** FC Feature Completion Track Execution Authority v0.2 — CURRENT / FC-01 P23 Accepted (fc-feature-completion-execution-v0.2) and seven decisions accepted by . - **Current additive Shape/2 semantic Authority:** (fc01-shape-triangle-semantic-v0.1). Historical Shape/1, Operation/1, Brush-v2 exception, Connector/1 and the exact V1 old-negative SH-G06 retain their own frozen authority. - **Architecture/design inputs (not code truth):** P14; P15; P16; P17. - **Inherited FC-track Verification Design:** FC-00 P20 v0.2 (accepted via P23), namespaces FC20-DEV-01..09 and DEV-vs-PHYS separation. **Legacy source-qualified physical debt:** 23 Windows + 23 Web exact PX0 H1/H2 controls (not older 18-group summary); FC-13 test timing and original gate independence. - **Implementation reality reference only:** github:Mostorm-Labs/axiom@2942c63b375366ed977b834aa0a48fe2fb551c6e. Existing code has Semantic/ReferenceObjectStore tests, Scene full/incremental comparison, Input session, History, Surface tracker and Facade tests, but no implemented FC-01 Shape/2 or five-tool acceptance suite. Current `verification/corpus/semantic/v1/suites/shape-kind-v1.json` is `status=candidate, vectors=[]`: **do not mistake it for an executed authoritative SH-G01..18 Golden**. - **Must not alter:** Shape-kind conversion forbidden; Line/Arrow remains Connector/1 FreePoint Straight; Triangle (Shape=1,kindVersion=2,shapeKind=3), Operation envelope (schema1,payload1); Snapshot2 + explicit reader feature; no new OperationKind/proto tags; basic FC-01 far-axis create Snap only; no FC-06 attachment/routing, FC-07 full align, FC-10 Clipboard, FC-02/05 Text. - **Gate identity:** `FC-01-DEV` only, scope=development_only, exact submitted source revision/verified ancestors. No physical or shipping claim; FC-13 and original P34 remain separate. ## 1. Evidence qualification rule and frozen classification For every required proof use exactly: ```plain text Requirement -> Invariant -> High-impact failure mode -> Existing independent coverage -> Residual detection gap -> Independent oracle/reference -> Fixture/corpus -> Reproducible execution -> Durable EvidenceArtifact -> BLOCKING or CORROBORATIVE -> Gate criterion. ``` - Blocking **only** when absence leaves a material high-impact correctness/compatibility/data-integrity/ownership failure mode without credible independent detection. Do not turn screenshots, trace cosmetics, duplicate platform runs, provenance-of-provenance or performance aspirations into new Gate blockers. - Requirement states *what must hold*. Oracle is an independently authored falsifiable decision procedure. Evidence is the *exact observed result of executing that oracle*. A green log without a valid independent oracle is insufficient. - Oracle expected results are authority-derived/manual or independent analytical/reference results, **never captured from production output** and auto-blessed. Two runners using the same oracle count as one mechanism. Where a second observation is essential, specify its different mechanism, not a second filename. - Known-bad old behavior must RED before implementation when practical; if the RED accepts known-bad source, return `VERIFICATION_DESIGN_DEFECT` instead of changing the test to follow implementation. - **Freeze stability:** once P31 materializes a content-addressed obligation set, P34 evaluates that set and newly discovered genuinely high-impact uncovered failure modes only; no retroactive confidence-only expansion. ## 2. Minimal uniquely-qualified blocking obligation set
Obligation Material gap and FC20 inheritance Required independent detection / evidence bundle
FC01-B01 Semantic tuple & codec Unsupported Shape/2 accepted, V1 SH-G06 corrupted, invalid wire silently normalized; FC20-DEV-01 Manual versioned expected cases + independent wire/reference parser vs production A-lane + canonical bytes. E01
FC01-B02 Atomic Apply / Snapshot / Replay / mixed client Wrong-version partial commit, typed bypass or lossy old reader; FC20-DEV-01 Reference-object reducer/ledger + independent capability profile and loading-state oracle. E02
FC01-B03 Gesture terminality / source loss Ghost/duplicate Insert, source A canceling B, late Up causing commit; FC20-DEV-03 Scripted PointerKey owner states vs independent canonical ledger+object count; RED-01. E03
FC01-B04 Far-axis Snap / transient preview Distant perpendicular candidate missed, nondeterministic latch, hidden commit jump or semantic side effect; FC20-DEV-02/03 Manually computed coordinate/axis baseline + independent linear reference selector + semantic-zero observer. E04
FC01-B05 Geometry / HitTest / Scene / Render Triangle wrong winding/bounds or Connector invisible, stale incremental projection; FC20-DEV-02 Analytical geometry/hit oracles + FullScene/ReferenceLinearIndex vs incremental and headless render probes. E05
FC01-B06 Editor commands / History conflict Wrong inverse, two-op fake resize, remote-dependent cascade deletion, cursor advances on failure; FC20-DEV-01/03 Manual before/post graph + independent reference reducer and conditional same-lane interleavings. E06
FC01-B07 Typed Facade / owner-safe-point Wrong tool/preset, stale target, reentrant Apply or false Applied readback; FC20-DEV-03/06 Forced ordering/queued dispatch and complete receipt-vs-commit comparison with independent owner trace. E07
FC01-B08 Host bridge / build / lifecycle Windows/Web/Android input/Token/epoch/attach mismatch, unsupported build or double camera transform; FC20-DEV-06 Changed-target compile/link and deterministic host contract fixtures, real-platform unique risks as FC-13 debt. E08
FC01-B09 Local/remote publish and outcome separation Remote echo, phantom saved/presented, wrong generation or partial READY; FC20-DEV-01/05/06 Independent local-vs-remote publication recorder, qualified frame provider token check, Axis status observer. E09
FC01-B10 Scope / inherited regression / result identity Wrong revision/golden mutation or regression admitted as FC-01 DEV PASS; FC20-DEV-05/07 Exact source/lock/corpus fingerprints, diff scope, affected old V1 and existing Ink/Selection/Render regressions. E10
All E01–E10 are **one logical required evidence family each**, potentially compiled from multiple test cases in a single provider run. Do not require ten separate CI jobs, ten videos, or duplicate cross-platform screenshots. Execution can share a runner, but expected-value provenance and actual observation must remain independently inspectable. ## 3. FC01-B01 — Triangle tuple, strict wire, byte Golden and V1 preservation **Requirement/Invariant:** accepted tuple list = \{(Shape1,version1,kind1), (Shape1,version1,kind2), (Shape1,version2,kind3)\} and only these. For Shape/2 operations use Operation(schemaVersion1,payloadVersion1). Existing Brush-v2 payload2 special case preserved, no generic payload2 extension. Entire malformed batch fails without mutation. **Failure/Impact:** silently treating V1 shapeKind3 as Triangle, auto-Rectangle fallback, malformed canonical f64/presence admission, wrong-version writable data loss. **HIGH / DATA INTEGRITY**. **Existing independent detection:** historical semantic conformance, G1-04-C independently authored 90-case fixture lineage, Envelope Validation and codec negative tests; but no credible FC-01 Shape2 bytes/tuple coverage and current shape-kind-v1 suite is empty. **Residual unique gap:** exactly joined version tuple, canonical serialization and preserved historical negative/positive outcomes in a new reader. **Oracle:** manual authority-derived expected triples, explicit field-presence and normalized f64 checks from unchanged .proto + frozen wire rules, independently authored reference decoder; compare canonical bytes against versioned *hand-reviewed* binary vector, not production-generated expected bytes. Run valid Shape/2 and old SH-G06 **together** with the same numeric shapeKind=3 but different kind_version. Negative operation/corpus leaves ObjectStore, ledger, semantic generation, CommitStamp, History, Axis publication unchanged. **Fixtures:** preserve all historical `SH-G01..SH-G18` without editing original source; materialize a separate `SH2-G01..SH2-G25` corpus (Section 4). Include missing explicit scalar field, unknown/duplicate singular canonical field, negative-zero→zero rejection, non-finite/oversized extents, wrong oneof branch and Brush-v2 positive/negative envelope controls. **Execution:** independent static/canonical wire fixture preflight; run semantic codec/validator tests against candidate on exact source; compare authoritative expected case-by-case, run canonical encode(decode(bytes)) byte roundtrip only where canonical profile requires; compare reference projection bytes/digest for old cohort. **Artifact/classification:** `E01/semantic-shape2-corpus-results.json` plus authoritative fixture manifests/sha256, canonical-byte compare and first divergent field. **BLOCKING** because old V1 tests cannot detect this new subtype/wire regression. **Criterion:** 100% enumerated *required* positive/negative outcomes exact; ZERO unexplained changed historical V1 canonical byte/golden; no partial mutation on reject. Any missing required fixture/byte authority = `BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT` before P31, not auto-golden acceptance. ## 4. Golden authoring/freeze: SH2-G01..25; no Golden-by-implementation P12's `SH2-G01..25` are **design seeds**, not executed or already-frozen bytes. Bind them into one manually reviewed, independently authored corpus with stable IDs; a case is not an independent evidence artifact merely because it has a separate ID.
IDs Exact Authority-derived expectations to materialize
SH2-G01..04 W100/H80 Triangle vertices (50,0),(100,80),(0,80), bbox \[0,0\]–\[100,80\]; fill/hit inside (50,40) and boundary (50,80), outside (5,10),(50,-1); centroid (50,160/3) vs Snap BBox center (50,40); size 200×40 changes derived vertices, not ObjectId/kind.
SH2-G05..08 Original Shape/1 rectangle/ellipse remain accepted and identical; Shape/1 kind3 (including old SH-G06) REJECT; Shape/2 kinds1/2,0/4+, kindVersion3+ REJECT. No fallback.
SH2-G09..12 Zero, negative, NaN/Inf, negative-zero and missing required W/H/shape kind REJECT; mismatched ObjectKind/kind_version/oneof REJECT before mutation.
SH2-G13..14 None Fill + None Stroke + opacity-default is valid under existing Field Registry; translation/rotation/reflection affect only derived geometry, not stored ShapeContent.
SH2-G15..16 Canonical protobuf field ordering, explicit presence, normalized f64 and exact binary Golden; new reader preserves old valid Snapshot/Operation bytes and semantics.
SH2-G17..19 Snapshot2+Shape2-capable reader roundtrips IDs/fields; Snapshot1+Triangle REJECT; V1-only reader rejects Triangle snapshot or insertion with no partial state/convert.
SH2-G20..23 Insert→Undo→Restore exact state/ID; Connector AttachedEndpoint to Triangle still REJECT; old V1 golden/descriptor remains unchanged while new registry bundle differs; incompatible peer capability prevents unsafe writable commit.
SH2-G24..25 Uncommitted preview/cancel = no canonical object/ID generation/semantic revision; invalid lengths, duplicate singular or disallowed wire fields reject under original canonical preflight.
**Required independent fixture provenance (to be materialized before P31):** - `verification/corpus/semantic/shape2-triangle/v1/authoring/{cases,expected}.json` — manually reviewed expected root with P23/Shape2 references; not generated from implementation output. - `verification/corpus/semantic/shape2-triangle/v1/{manifest.json,wire/}` — exact fixture bytes/sha256, compiler identity and authored expected digest, generation method; original `verification/corpus/semantic/v1/` remains untouched. - `verification/corpus/fc01/v1/scenarios.json` — separate finite pointer, history, snap, compat and host scenario IDs with frozen expected results. Paths are P31 **planned materialization**, **NOT files asserted to exist** at this design stage. - **Canonical-byte precondition:** SH2-G15 expected binary and independent field-accounting must be pinned/reviewed **before P31**. Generated production serializer output may only fill Actual, NEVER update Expected. If old SH-G01..18 authority case source is not resolvable, fail closed; do not claim the empty placeholder suite is equivalent. - Hash-only manifest without inspectable expected values is insufficient. No second recursive “prove the fixture compiler” blocking chain unless a concrete uncovered high-impact failure and lack of independent validator are shown. ## 5. FC01-B02 — atomic apply, Snapshot/Replay and reader/writer refusal **Invariant:** typed/direct, encoded, Restore, Replay, Snapshot bootstrap and remote ingress all enforce structural A + stateful B version checks and OperationId exact idempotency. Rejected mixed batch changes nothing. Snapshot containing Triangle must be schemaVersion2 AND reader-capable; old clients never writable-roundtrip Triangle. Loading failure never exposes partially READY. **High-impact mode:** typed OperationEngine bypasses validation, semantic ledger duplicates, prior Replay ops leak through failed Loading, old writer drops Shape2 bytes. **HIGH / DATA LOSS / COMPATIBILITY**. **Existing independent:** G1 reference reducer/ledger, old snapshot and replay tests; they have no Shape2 or mixed peer-capability data. **Gap & unique value:** boundary admission on every ingress and capability negotiation across stream/open/export, not just direct Codec decode. **Oracle/fixture:** (a) same authored valid/invalid Operation through direct typed Engine, wire decoder, replay, History inverse and remote harness with expected identical admit/reject, (b) ReferenceObjectStore + hand-computed before/after digest and ledger/generation/ChangeSet counts, (c) independent capability profile V1-only vs Shape2 reader/writer matrix; old reader may be represented by pinned V1-only reference reader plus product bridge feature-off adapter, not by having new production reader bless itself, (d) two-op Replay stream legal first + illegal Shape2 second: private Loading may have first applied, but state MUST be Failed/quarantined and never Ready/writable/published as accepted document, (e) no lossy snapshot/Operation re-encode. **Cases:** insert/reject/restore; invalid among otherwise valid staged records; same OperationId/same canonical bytes AlreadyApplied =\> no generation; same ID/different canonical payload Collision =\> no mutation; Snapshot1 Triangle, Snapshot2 without capability, Snapshot2+capability; Brush2 payload2 positive / Triangle payload2 negative; connector AttachedEndpoint Triangle reject; peer capability revoked before unsafe new Triangle write or new-write refused. **Method:** deterministic in-process semantic/Codec/Replay differential plus independently enumerated read/write capability state table; inject mismatches before each ingress; inspect pristine vs final store+ledger+ChangeSet/History/Axis publication and document READY. **Artifact:** `E02/ingress-snapshot-replay-compat.json`, input hash, exact per-ingress result and private Loading/READY transitions. **BLOCKING** because existing G1 V1 suite lacks this whole-version stream policy. **Gate:** all required A/B paths reject disallowed cases, no partial exposed state or silent downgrade, valid reader roundtrips same 128-bit ObjectIds and canonical state; incompatible writer cannot edit/export/replay. ## 6. FC01-B03 — Input ownership, terminal gesture, commit exactly once **Requirement/Invariant:** five Create presets share InputRouter/Interaction claim. Down freezes style+camera/preset; Move only updates per-view transient preview; confirmed legal Up yields **one** existing InsertObjects of exactly one object. Cancel before submit yields zero Operations. Duplicate Up/late ACK and sourceLost never resurrect gestures. SourceLost(A) must not cancel sourceB. **Impact:** ghost creations, lost active pointer, unexpected deletion or duplicated canonical Op after timeout, user input cross-contamination. **HIGH / UNINTENDED MUTATION**. **Existing independent coverage:** old G4 InputRouter/Session/viewport/Ink tests check related behavior, but no Create session or two-source isolation negative. Current [PlatformInteractionIngress::sourceLost](https://github.com/Mostorm-Labs/axiom/blob/2942c63b375366ed977b834aa0a48fe2fb551c6e/runtime/input/src/platform_interaction_ingress.cpp) is known-bad: it constructs source-A cancels then global-cancels all active sources through `batch.sourceLost=true`. **Residual unique detection:** actual Create session ownership and *input + canonical* independent observation; preserved source B while source A is lost. **Oracle:** scripted sealed PointerSampleBatch inputs with independent expected PointerKey/claim terminal states; separately query canonical OperationId ledger, total ObjectRecords and SemanticGeneration after each phase. No success based solely on UI render/counter. Must include valid Up, invalid extent, predicted-only samples, cross-source A/B concurrent, tool-switch/Up serialization, camera/Target epoch detach, lost ACK and exact same OperationId duplicate. Distinguish receipt Queued from actual Applied. **RED-01 (MANDATORY precondition):** on old anchored source, Down(A:source11,pointer7) and Down(B:source22,pointer7), call `sourceLost(11)`; **expected B remains active, its exact PointerKey accepted and B Up can complete**. Old implementation cancels both. Baseline run MUST produce RED on this invariant before P32 changes production source. A green baseline on this known defect is `VERIFICATION_DESIGN_DEFECT`, not acceptance. Observe `keyFor(22,7)`, active Count, cancel output for B and later B Up, not just A's cancellation. **Fixtures:** `FC01-IN-01..` valid five presets; `IN-06` degenerate/cancel; `IN-07` duplicate Down/Up/late ACK; `IN-08` A/B sourceLost; `IN-09` tool-switch/Up race; `IN-10` camera/attachment stale; `IN-11` UI capture-latch; `IN-12` predicted current versus confirmed. Internal labels are test namespace, not new product behavior. **Method:** run deterministic source-ordered steps and forced owner queue phases; sample per-step (session/claim count, preview id, OperationId/ledger/object count/generation). Verify each accepted gesture creates exactly one versioned object, each pre-submit cancel creates zero, pending outcome is not retried with new OpId, no unrelated source cancel. **Artifact:** `E03/interaction-create-red-and-green.json` including old RED (anchored revision, exact scenario) and candidate GREEN; first-divergence diff and complete canonical observer. **BLOCKING** because old G4 tests cannot falsify the new Create/session cross-source failure. **Criterion:** RED preflight acts as specified; candidate has zero duplicate commits, zero transient→Canonical leak and independent source isolation, exact class-based outcomes. ## 7. FC01-B04 — Far-axis Snap/Guide and zero canonical preview **Requirement:** while drawing Shape/Connector, eligible **visible committed Shape** targets anywhere within the visible viewport's perpendicular extent can contribute center/edge axis candidates even if physically far from pointer along that perpendicular axis. Threshold and hysteresis in logical view pixels, stable tie-break and target-specific revalidation on Up. Snap/Guides exist only in the per-view transient layer. **Failure/Impact:** obvious alignment not offered, stale/incorrect constraints, nondeterministic or invisible Up jump, premature semantic publication. **HIGH / EDIT CORRECTNESS**. **Existing coverage:** G4.6 pointer-nearby Snap/SceneQuery and transient presenter; these may not test **far perpendicular** targets or combined preview-vs-commit behavior. **Unique gap:** indexed viewport axis-strip query agrees with an independently authored exhaustive **viewport-bounded** linear candidate oracle; compare first-best selection under target permutations and zoom/DPR/rotation. Linear oracle used only in verification; production cannot do an unbounded whole-Document scan. **Oracle:** expected feature coordinates from manually authored world-space rectangles; freeze scene, world→logical camera mapping and enter/release parameters from **candidate's accepted common runtime tuning profile**, not hardcoded OS values. Compare axis candidates, tie order, latched identity, delta, guide endpoints and final W/H+Transform or Connector FreePoints. Cases: - A distant-y target with matching X bbox center/edge found despite pointer-near radius missing it; a distant-x target for Y alignment similarly. - nearest adjustment and deterministic tie-break across reversed object insertion order; visible locked Shape is eligible passive reference, hidden/out-of-viewport/preview/unsupported never considered; no self-target. - zoom 0.5/1/2 and distinct DPR 1/2/3 use same **logical-pixel** threshold; world feature projection evaluated analytically. Rotation requires world-axis constraints with conservative finite viewport query; invalid transform reports unavailable and cannot create jump. - hysteresis: acquire when \|logical correction\| ≤ profile enter and hold until \> release; no magic cross-platform defaults. Mid-drag target moved/deleted updates visible preview **before Up** or Up rejects; after Up no hidden re-snap. - verify 100 Move frames → 0 canonical Operations/generation change/Axis new outgoing; cancel after preview → no persisted guide/object. **Method:** deterministic synthetic view + ReferenceLinearIndex ranked candidate function (independently coded from P11/G4.6 feature policy, not calling SnapResolver), run same scene against indexed implementation; compare exact stable ObjectIds, feature keys, snapped point and typed final object record. **Artifact:** `E04/snap-guide-independent-differential.json`, per-view proposed vs canonical digest and invariants. **BLOCKING** (old nearby query cannot detect far-axis miss). **Criterion:** exact target selection/tie/hysteresis under frozen profile; no invalid preview→semantic mutation; no invisible Up delta change; production query remains finite viewport-indexed. **No unaccepted numeric performance/FPS budget** may be introduced as a blocking P20 criterion. ## 8. FC01-B05 — Triangle/Connector HitTest, Scene and renderer geometry parity **Requirement:** versioned Shape/2 local vertices A=(W/2,0), B=(W,H), C=(0,H), closed; W100,H80 reference vertices (50,0),(100,80),(0,80), bbox \[0,0\]×\[100,80\], bbox Snap center (50,40), area centroid (50,160/3) **not** Snap feature. Connector/1 Line/Arrow preserve oriented FreePoint endpoints, Straight routing, endDecoration Arrow only for Arrow. Semantic scene full/incremental and rendered/hit geometry must agree. **Impact:** invisible/non-selectable Connector, Triangle mistaken for Rectangle, false hit outside fill, stale bounds/raster after edits, wrong arrow direction. **HIGH / VISIBLE CONTENT & EDIT TARGET**. **Existing detection:** G2 FullSceneCompiler / ReferenceLinearIndex / scene spatial index differential; G3 Direct NonTiled reference render; G4.6 EditingOverlay and hit/transform tests. They lack Shape2 Triangle exact vertex/hit and the FC-01 FreePoint Connector selection path. **Unique gap:** independent analytic triangle point-in-polygon/distance-to-edge and line segment/arrowhead hit reference, under Transform2D (translation/rotation/reflection) and effective Fill/Stroke/Opacity/None. Compare SceneCompiler full rebuild vs incremental projection, ReferenceLinearIndex vs production index and headless CPU reference mask probes vs Skia derived raster. **Cases:** identity+rotated/mirrored Triangle, filled interior vs boundary/outside; no-fill stroke-only; both None; stroke width; resized intrinsic vs transformed visual size; invalid hidden/locked hit policy; line segment hit at interior and outside slop, arrowhead triangle and reversed-end arrow; the current `HitTestKindMask::kAll` missing Connector must be corrected; render scene generation and bounds only advance on canonical changes. Compare at logical-pixel probes known well inside/outside stroke/fill, and boundary within a pinned conservative raster tolerance only. **Render metric:** deterministic headless Skia reference profile must fix source/SDK, surface dimensions, DPR, colorspace, AA configuration and byte representation. Inside/outside oracle must **not depend on raster generated by candidate itself**. Require exact structural geometry/bounds/hit values and pixel-mask classification at interior/outside probe points. For AA boundary samples use explicit independent analytic tolerance (distance ≤ 1 **headless reference physical pixel** in the pinned CPU profile only), not universal whole-image byte equality across Windows/Web/Android GPUs; any device/backend anti-alias difference is a later physical qualification issue. **Method:** replay authored one-operation edits, independently compute expected geometry and transformed bbox, compare Full/Incremental Scene and precise hit outputs, reference linear index candidates, and headless renderer probe mask. No screenshot asserted as sufficient canonical proof. **Artifact:** `E05/scene-geometry-hit-render.json` and pinned headless mask/reference profile with first divergence. **BLOCKING** because old Scene tests have no new Shape2/Arrow coverage. **Criterion:** exact semantic tuple/geometry and precise selection consistent with analytical reference; no stale derived projection after committed size/style/transform/order/delete, zero changes on canceled transient; only approved headless reference tolerance applied to AA edges. ## 9. FC01-B06 — single-operation selected edits and conflict-safe History **Requirement:** SetFill/Stroke/Width/Opacity/Lock via one PatchProperties; handle resize via **one SetTransforms** with unchanged local W/H; numeric size via **one SetObjectSize** with unchanged Transform; layer-order via one SetPlacements; Delete via one DeleteObjects; each successful local FC01 intent has one History entry and one conditional inverse/redo Operation with a **fresh OperationId**. Locked is local editor-control (visible/selectable/Unlock possible), NOT universal semantic parser ban. **Failure/Impact:** remote-dependent objects are silently cascade-deleted on Undo, partial two-op resize, wrong style preimage, stale cursor after failed undo or missing restored ObjectId. **HIGH / DATA INTEGRITY**. **Existing coverage:** EditorHistory legacy Undo for transforms/eraser and Delete/Restore, G1 DeleteClosure and ReferenceObjectStore. No safe FC-01 Insert/Patch/Size/Placement inverse matrix and no same-lane dependence check on new Shape2 + Connector. **Unique gap:** independent recorded before/after ObjectRecord projection plus child/connector dependency graph compared to current canonical state at **commit point**, not a potentially stale UI precheck. Deterministic interleaving: local Shape insert -\> remote child/Connector depends on it -\> local Undo attempt; expected Conflict, zero semantic delta, cursor unchanged, remote dependent survives. Independent opposite case without dependent legitimately deletes only originally created object. Repeat for Delete/Restore with complete DeleteClosure. **Other cases:** size/transform single-Op counts and unchanged counterpart; PropertyBag explicit prior value vs absent/Clear; stable full Placement OrderKey; Locked select→Unlock works yet drag/delete blocked in local editor; user makes new edit after Undo → normal redo branch truncation; failed/rejected/AlreadyApplied never creates a second history entry; Undo/Redo successful allocate fresh OperationId, preserve original ObjectId where applicable. **Method:** use manually authored reference graph/preimage (not reading candidate History's own stored inverse as oracle), inject remote commits between local forward and undo, force contradictory updates at execution queue boundary, compare committed ledger counts, object graph, field values, cursor, ChangeSet, eventual replay digest. History conditional validation and Apply must be one serialized commit operation. The old `editor_history.cpp` support matrix is incomplete; this is an implementation obligation, not authority to add a new op. **Artifact:** `E06/history-preimage-closure.json` including interleaving schedules, before/after reference graph and cursor. **BLOCKING** because existing tests cannot detect unrelated remote data deletion. **Criterion:** all accepted single-op intents have valid exact inverse and Redo; incompatible current-state/dependency causes Conflict before mutation and leaves cursor/ledger/records unchanged; no double-write atomicity fiction. ## 10. FC01-B07 — common typed Facade, owner queue, receipt and snapshot **Requirement:** exactly five typed CreationPreset kinds distinct from BrushPreset; one common RuntimeFacade/CanvasControlService for Product Shell and Debug UI. Control state is per-view/editor, canonical is shared. Owner safe-point drain controls mutations; no arbitrary reentrant port.apply from UI/JNI/WASM event; coherent readback includes tool/preset/future style, full selected ObjectId/version/Lock/history/current context, capability reasons, last control/semantic result. **Failure/Impact:** wrong preset after tool switch, stale CanvasTargetKey edits a newly rebound view, UI reports "object saved" from Queued, direct reentrant mutation corrupts input or history. **HIGH / OWNER & USER TRUTH**. **Existing coverage:** CanvasControlService queue/receipt dedup tests; DUI-M1 control tests; Product Shell generation contract. Current `CanvasRuntimeFacadeAdapter::submitCanvasControl` inline `processPending` does not itself prove the owner safe point across multiple host contexts. **Unique gap:** race/owner-affinity behavior and new typed tool/style command API absent from existing test set. **Oracle:** verification-only serialized scheduler with phase labels `UI_enqueue` → `owner_dispatch` → `Semantic_Applied` → `Scene_published` → `Presented`/`Axis_Durable`. Instrumented owner port rejects port.apply outside authorized owner phase or when reentrant; schedule UI call concurrently with pointer Up/HostDetach/BindingGeneration replacement and verify correct result by independent applied-op ledger + ControlSnapshot/controlRevision. No dependence on implementation "I used a mutex" assertion. **Cases:** all five presets and future-style selection; style option change mid-drag affects **next** gesture only; selected-object PatchProperties differs from create defaults; unsupported Text/Copy/Duplicate/advanced Connector disabled; client request duplicate/expired/high-water/QueueFull; stale workspace/view/attachment/binding; two views share Document but independent tool/camera/preview; full 128-bit ID preserved through JS-safe token representation (beyond 2\^53 to catch float truncation). Use both Product and Debug clients with same expected readback. **Method:** deterministic forced interleaving, control queue drain manually sequenced; correlate (clientId,requestId) control receipts to actual (CreateIntentId,OperationId) semantic events. Use target-safe-point handler whose authorized thread/phase is independently observable; compare real snapshot against model projection, no separate UI truth. **Artifact:** `E07/facade-owner-queue-readback.json` with deterministic owner phase labels and immutable snapshots, exact target tokens. **BLOCKING** because false mutation success/stale editing is not detected by canonical-only tests. **Criterion:** zero reentrant off-owner Apply, zero stale target mutation, complete common typed command/readback, proper phase ordering and unsupported truthful reason. ## 11. FC01-B08 — Windows/Web/Android bridge, input units, lifecycle and build contracts **Requirement:** all three supported FC-01 development targets bind the *same* Runtime/Interaction/Semantic owner while preserving platform-appropriate hot-input, control, opaque IDs, DPI and generation contracts. Input/Render/Surface/Document lifecycle axes remain distinct. **Failure/Impact:** RN/TS/Java builds wrong ABI or truncates 128-bit ID, double-transforms strokes, loses last Up, ignores stale Workspace/Binding/Surface epochs, or silently mutates on unsupported host. **HIGH / PLATFORM CONTRACT & DATA INTEGRITY**. **Existing coverage:** G3/G4/G4.6/G4.7 existing build and host profiles, Product Shell/Debug P20 and published platform harnesses. Existing Win32/Android Java demos and simple Web event adapter do not prove FC-01 integration or production RNW/RN Native Component. **Residual unique gap:** newly added CreationPreset/selected-object API and pointer ownership/lifecycle behavior across all three adapters, without promoting mock input to physical proof. **Independent DEV oracle:** changed-host compile+link of exact candidate source against declared Windows native, Web Emscripten and Android native SDK profiles *where FC-01 code affects them*; deterministic host adapter contract tests with separately authored expected logical-view/world mapping and input sequences, plus independent opaque-token precision boundary and expected generation/capability matrix.
